summary_paraphrase: Two inseparable bushbaby friends turn down every other classmate; when one is ill, the other is drawn in by a classmate making a get-well card, plays with everyone, and on the friend's return helps the friend accept the new circle.

characters.name: Zindzi
characters.desire: to keep doing everything with Tim Tam
characters.change: from a closed pair to an open circle; then teaches it to Tim Tam

characters.name: Tim Tam
characters.change: from jealous question to 'let's all be best friends'

characters.name: Oswin
characters.relation_to_protagonist: classmate who becomes a new friend

characters.name: Teacher
characters.relation_to_protagonist: teacher; suggests other friends but does not solve it

humor_notes: Light: the painting chant, the animals' costumes (pirate hat, unicorn horn), the porcupine teacher's clogs.

repetition.description: three invitations in a row, each declined with the same reply shape
repetition.why: builds a pattern the reader can predict, which the illness breaks and page 8 reverses

repetition.description: the same polite refusal line opens Zindzi's reply three times
repetition.why: easy to join in; its absence later marks the change

repetition.description: a short painting chant spoken by both characters
repetition.why: the echoed chant is the moment the two become partners

repetition.description: each classmate who was declined is played with in turn (dress-up and scooters return; the hare's game becomes hopscotch)
repetition.why: the reversal is enacted, not stated

repetition.description: title phrase 'best friends' returns widened to the whole group
repetition.why: closes the arc by redefining the opening words

notes: Scale carries feeling: Zindzi is drawn tiny when alone, large when paired.
Page 9 shows Oswin reading alone, mirroring the opening pair: the picture shows who is now left out.

strengths: a three-part pattern set up, broken and then reversed by action
the friendship problem is felt from both sides (left-out, then replaced)
weaknesses: the friend's jealousy is settled in two pages
hopscotch is played with the hare although her offered game was a puzzle — a small continuity slip

anti_patterns.note: Tim Tam's fear of being replaced is answered within one spread

child_appeal_heuristic.label: Research heuristic — not validated
child_appeal_heuristic.rationale: Scores are the analyst's reading of the pages, not observations of children.

age_suitability.notes: School-friendship setting; mild sadness and jealousy, both resolved warmly.

metrics.lexicon_note: direct_address and sound_words are lexicon counts: a floor, not a measure. direct_address counts second-person words anywhere, dialogue included — it is not narrator-to-reader address

repetition.end_rhyme_note: heuristic: consecutive lines sharing a final two letters
